import sys
import math

n, m = 0, 0
p = [0.0] * 20
res = [0.0] * (1 << 20)
q = [0.0] * 20

def main():
    global n, m, p, res, q
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n_val, m_val = int(input_data[0]), int(input_data[1])
    n, m = n_val, m_val
    index = 2
    for i in range(n):
        p[i] = float(input_data[index])
        index += 1
        res[1 << i] = p[i]
        q[i] = 0.0
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        selected = []
        unselected = []
        sum_unselected = 0.0
        for j in range(n):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                selected.append(j)
            else:
                unselected.append(j)
                sum_unselected += p[j]
        if len(selected) == m or (len(selected) < m and sum_unselected < 1e-5):
            for x in selected:
                q[x] += res[mask]
        elif len(selected) < m:
            for x in unselected:
                res[mask | (1 << x)] += res[mask] * p[x] / sum_unselected
    print(' '.join(f"{q[i]:.15f}" for i in range(n)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
